import subprocess, time, os, json, glob
Q=json.dumps({"project":"code","format":"json","query":"MATCH (n) RETURN n.qualified_name, n.name, n.label, n.file_path","max_rows":50000,"max_output_tokens":100000000,"offset":0})

def procs():
    out={}
    for p in glob.glob('/proc/[0-9]*'):
        try:
            cmd=open(p+'/cmdline','rb').read().split(b'\0')

            env=open(p+'/environ','rb').read()
            if RT.encode() not in env: continue

            io=dict(l.split(': ') for l in open(p+'/io').read().splitlines())

def watch(argv,label):
    t0=time.time(); p=subprocess.Popen(argv,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    seen={}; first={}; last={}
    while True:
        now=time.time()-t0
        ps=procs()
        for pid,v in ps.items():
            first.setdefault(pid,now); last[pid]=now; seen[pid]=v
        if p.poll() is not None and not ps: break
        if now>30: break

watch(["codebase-memory-mcp","cli","--quiet","--json","query_graph",Q],"cli query_graph")
watch(["codebase-memory-mcp","cli","--quiet","--json","list_projects",'{"format":"json"}'],"cli list_projects")
EOF
